title: StormCheck calibration file (data/calibration.json, engine/default_calibration.json)
description: One logistic model per Confidence.kind: p = 1 / (1 + exp(-(intercept + sum(coef[i] * x[features[i]])))). A kind with no model gives Confidence.score = null ("uncalibrated"). Caps are reported as chips and never folded into the score. Logistic regression only (CONTRACTS §6).

version.description: Shown as Confidence.calibration_version and in commit inputs as cal@<version>

model.description: len(coef) == len(features); every feature must be listed for its kind in x-features.

x-encoding.in_window_dep: 1.0 if the departure end is "in" a storm window, else 0.0 ("unknown" is 0.0 and routes to Ops)
x-encoding.in_window_arr: 1.0 if the arrival end is "in", else 0.0
x-encoding.window_margin_h: |FlightDecision.window_margin_min| / 60, capped at 4.0; 0.0 when there is no window
x-encoding.aog_before_window: 1.0 if a no-MEL-relief AOG on the tail was logged before the window
x-encoding.aog_inside_window: 1.0 if the AOG was logged inside the window (concurrent causes)
x-encoding.root_cause_internal: 1.0 if engine/ata_table.py classifies the defect as internal
x-encoding.sources_disagree: 1.0 if the winning evidence contradicts a lower-tier source on the decisive field
x-encoding.precedent_count: matching history_cases + 10 per binding ruling, capped at 10
x-encoding.in_lieu: 1.0 if a voucher was issued in lieu of compensation
x-encoding.cohort_age_months: months since the cohort's M1 (M1 = first month-end ≥28 days after the event)
x-encoding.months_since_last_claim: months since the latest approved claim
x-encoding.channel_agency: 1.0 if the claim came through an agency
x-encoding.authority_none: 1.0 if an agency claim has authority=none
x-encoding.duplicate: 1.0 if another claim/refund exists on the coupon
x-encoding.after_limitation: 1.0 if received after the limitation date
x-encoding.age_months: months between the flight and the claim
